title: Password change, reset, recovery and account management are delegated to the provider's self-service surface
description: The blueprint contributes the `credentialSelfService` capability by resolving and exposing the provider record's `accountUrl` field (a URL the provider documents for account, password and recovery self-service; for example Google's https://myaccount.google.com, GitHub's https://github.com/settings/security). The provider adapter verifies at boot that every enabled provider record carries `accountUrl` as an absolute https URL under the provider's documented origin (or an explicit `null` when the provider offers no self-service surface); a provider that declares `credentialSelfService` support without an `accountUrl` is refused with `OAUTH2_ACCOUNT_URL_MISSING`. The project exposes `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl(principal)` that returns the resolved URL for the principal's provider; a project page linking to self-service reads that helper rather than hard-coding a URL. No project route renders a credential-change form of its own.
rationale: A capability declaration for `credentialSelfService` on an OAuth2/OIDC blueprint whose sign-in is already delegated makes little sense unless the account-management surface is also delegated by contract; naming the `accountUrl` field and the boot-time verification is what turns the capability into a bind-able surface.
